name: ai-image-prompt-factory
title_zh: 先锁死画面再动笔的 GPT Image 提示词工厂
tagline_zh: 给 GPT Image 2 写提示词，最怕它自由发挥。这个 Skill 用显式锁、参考图隔离、年代文化证据。
tagline_en: Tired of GPT Image 2 freelancing your vision? This skill nails every visual decision with explicit locks.
desc_en: Evidence-backed agentic image-prompt engineering skill for GPT Image 2. Converts plain-language visual requests and optional reference images into coherent production prompts using explicit locks, reference-role isolation, temporal-cultural evidence, art/craft/material reasoning, visual direction, compatibility audits, regression checks, evaluation, and surgical revision. Prompt generation is the
why_zh: 不是生成器，是审计员。先做兼容性审计和回归检查，再动笔；改稿走外科手术式单点修订，不整段推翻。
why_en: It's an auditor, not a generator. Runs compatibility audits and regression checks before writing; revises surgically, not.
limit_zh: 只认 GPT Image 2 的提示词语法，不兼容其他图像模型；必须能联网查证年代/文化细节，离线时相关锁会失效。
limit_en: Only for GPT Image 2 syntax; needs internet for era/culture evidence; reference images must be URLs, local files rejected.
title_en: Image prompt factory that locks specs before writing
